title: My Mall Planet
content: I’ve spoken about this on comment threads before. These are most of the places I can remember - most in about an accurate position. Bali is missing. London is somewhere (but I’m only ever on a bridge across the Thames - which is always super dark), maybe not on anything I’ve listed here. I have lots of other places that don’t have an obvious country - I assume they are just my home town/region somewhere - these are a mix of urban (where I’ve been to actual malls) and rural. The only place I haven’t flown to is mid/eastern Europe. I’ve been there a few times, once was because I was in a movie.. the other time I was crossing a land border and Poland was to the south of the mountains range. Antarctica moves around the map sometimes it’s visible from other directions from Thailand… sometimes once you go around the north western tip of Thailand and then go down the eastern side you are in Western Australia.
